contracts: (Acceptance requires recorded equality of pre- and post-repair native command identities.) AND (Historical membership, paths, and bytes compare exactly equal before and after the operation.) AND (Success iff every required identity and execution fact passes presence, freshness, uniqueness, and verification checks.) AND (The Toolchain validator passes only when every successful Replay Result contains a recorded independent output verification assertion; any missing, self-reported-only, or failed independent check causes rejection.) AND (The identity validator returns rejected or blocked and records zero accepted operations for the substituted target.) AND (The validator rejects historical-only authorization and the emitted decision has no historical authorizing source.)
selector_intents: Change the native command executable or argument vector and verify identity comparison fails.
Mutate, remove, rename, relocate, or alter bytes of a frozen historical record and verify the historical-record manifest guard fails.
Remove pre/post identity evidence and verify acceptance fails.
Run the success-decision validator with one required identity or execution fact omitted, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable; it must reject success.
Select a successful Replay Result fixture whose output is present but whose verification record omits the independent output check; the validator must fail the acceptance oracle.
Use the existing authorization negative validator with historical evidence as the sole claimed authority; authorization must be rejected.
Use the existing read-only target validator selector with a required/supplied identity mismatch; validation must fail closed before dispatch.
